title: Familie-enquête Nederlandse bevolking 2003
contributors: Funding Agency: NWO - Nederlandse Organisatie voor Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek
descriptions: Life course and life situation of the Dutch population. Family of origin, educational career, labor market career, family formation, residential career, income, religion, values, leisure time behavior, cultural and material consumption, life satisfaction, health. Longitudinal survey. Also available in EASY: Familie-enquête Nederlandse bevolking / Family Survey Dutch Population 1992-1993, 1998, 2000 and 2009
